hints.title: Single Zero Allowance Window
hints.text: The problem is equivalent to finding the longest subarray containing at most one zero element.

hints.title: Zero Count Shrinkage Trigger
hints.text: Expand the right pointer while tallying zeros. When the zero count reaches two, increment the left pointer until one zero is discarded.

hints.title: Sliding Window Width Maximization
hints.text: Initialize left pointer and zero count to zero. For right from zero to n minus one, increment zero count if nums[right] is zero. While zero count exceeds one, decrement if nums[left] is zero and advance left. Update max length.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flipping each zero and recalculating maximum ones takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two pointers traverse the array at most twice in total, maintaining zero counts in O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the general at-most-k-zeros sliding window pattern with k=1.
